name: levmetamfetamine
uses: Use: for temporary relief of nasal congestion due to: the common cold hay fever or upper respiratory allergies
otcwarn: do not use for more than 7 days use only as directed frequent or prolonged use may cause nasal congestion to recur or worsen Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms persist
